channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: উত্তরাখণ্ডের নেহা বোরার রাজনৈতিক পরিচয়
item.description: ভারতের উত্তরাখণ্ডের খতিমা শহরে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন নেহা বোরা। তাঁর বাবা ভারতীয় সেনাবাহিনীর একজন সদস্য ছিলেন। বর্তমানে তিনি রাজনৈতিক অঙ্গনে নিজের অবস্থান তৈরি করছেন।

item.title: বন্ধুত্বের বিচ্ছেদের আশঙ্কায় সুজয়ের নীরবতা
item.description: বন্ধুত্বের সম্পর্ক নষ্ট হওয়ার ভয়ে সুজয় তার মনের কথা নিতুকে জানাতে পারছেন না। কর্মব্যস্ততা এবং ব্যক্তিগত দ্বিধার কারণে দীর্ঘ সময় ধরে তার এই অনুভূতিগুলো অপ্রকাশিতই থেকে যাচ্ছে।

item.title: Melania Trump reportedly facilitates truce in Oleshky
item.description: The White House announced a ceasefire in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city, though neither nation has verified the agreement. Residents in the area have faced extreme food shortages, reportedly consuming weeds to survive.

item.title: Fatal shooting at Jordanian funeral leaves six dead
item.description: Gunmen opened fire during a church funeral service in the Karak governorate of southern Jordan. Authorities report 28 injuries and have initiated a search for the attackers.

item.title: রিয়াদে হুতি হামলায় নিহত শাহেদ আহম্মেদের দাফন সম্পন্ন
item.description: সৌদি আরবের রাজধানী রিয়াদে ইয়েমেনের হুতি বিদ্রোহীদের হামলায় প্রাণ হারান প্রবাসী শাহেদ আহম্মেদ। তাঁর মরদেহ দেশে ফিরিয়ে এনে বগুড়ায় নিজ গ্রামে দাফন করা হয়েছে।

item.title: সাবেক অধিনায়কের বিরুদ্ধে প্রতিশ্রুতি ভঙ্গের অভিযোগ ভারতীয় লেগ স্পিনারের
item.description: ২০১৭ সালে শেষ আন্তর্জাতিক ম্যাচ খেলা এক লেগ স্পিনার জানান, ফিটনেস ফিরে পেলে দলে নেওয়ার আশ্বাস দিয়েছিলেন তৎকালীন অধিনায়ক বিরাট কোহলি। তবে পরবর্তীতে অধিনায়ক তাঁর ফোন ধরা বন্ধ করে দেন বলে তিনি দাবি করেন।

item.title: West Bank shooting leaves five Israelis hurt and two attackers dead
item.description: An incident in the West Bank resulted in five injured Israelis and the deaths of two suspected Palestinian assailants. The event occurred amid high regional tensions just days prior to Israel's national election.

item.title: Quest Diagnostics confirms health data breach
item.description: Quest Diagnostics has verified that patient health and personal information were accessed during a security breach. The company joins a growing list of healthcare firms targeted by hackers in recent months.

item.title: Lula and Bolsonaro face off in Brazil's election
item.description: Polls indicate a tightening race between incumbent Lula and rival Flavio Bolsonaro as Brazil approaches a second round of voting. The upcoming runoff follows a period of heightened political tension.

item.title: নিষিদ্ধ ছাত্রলীগের নেতাসহ দুজন আটক, ডিসেম্বরে হাসিনার ফেরার মাইকিং
item.description: ডিসেম্বরে শেখ হাসিনা দেশে ফিরবেন বলে ঘোষণা দিয়ে মাইকিং করার অভিযোগে নিষিদ্ধ ছাত্রলীগের এক নেতাসহ দুজনকে আটক করা হয়েছে।

item.title: জ্যারেড কুশনার ও ইভাঙ্কা ট্রাম্পের বিলাসবহুল জীবন এবং বিনিয়োগ
item.description: ডোনাল্ড ট্রাম্পের জামাতা জ্যারেড কুশনার ও ইভাঙ্কা ট্রাম্পের বিলাসী জীবনযাপন, প্রমোদতরীতে ভ্রমণ এবং আন্তর্জাতিক বিনিয়োগ সবসময় মানুষের আগ্রহের কেন্দ্রবিন্দুতে রয়েছে।

item.title: বাংলাদেশি তরুণদের সংগ্রাম নিয়ে যা বললেন নেহা বোরা
item.description: ভারতের বামপন্থী ছাত্রনেত্রী নেহা বোরার একটি ভিডিও সম্প্রতি সামাজিক মাধ্যমে ছড়িয়ে পড়ে। সেখানে তিনি চলতি গণঅভ্যুত্থানে বাংলাদেশের তরুণদের লড়াই থেকে অনুপ্রেরণা নেওয়ার কথা উল্লেখ করেন।

item.title: উষ্ণতম দশক ও জলবায়ু পরিবর্তনের প্রভাবে বিপন্ন প্রকৃতি
item.description: ২০২৫ সালে বৈশ্বিক গড় তাপমাত্রা প্রাক-শিল্পযুগের তুলনায় ১ দশমিক ৪৩ ডিগ্রি বেশি ছিল। ২০১৫ থেকে ২০২৫ সাল পর্যন্ত গত ১১ বছর রেকর্ড ইতিহাসের সবচেয়ে উষ্ণ সময় হিসেবে চিহ্নিত হয়েছে।

item.title: Chelsea and Tottenham prepare for another tense Premier League clash
item.description: Ahead of their latest Premier League fixture, past encounters between Chelsea and Tottenham Hotspur are reviewed, noting a history of high goals, drama, and intense on-field controversy.

item.title: পশ্চিম তীরে ইসরায়েলি সেনা নিহত, নেতানিয়াহুর কঠোর অভিযানের হুমকি
item.description: অধিকৃত পশ্চিম তীরের হেবরনে বন্দুকধারীর গুলিতে দুই ইসরায়েলি সেনা নিহত হয়েছেন। হামাস এই হামলার প্রশংসা করে আরও হামলার আহ্বান জানালে, ইসরায়েলি প্রধানমন্ত্রী কঠোর সামরিক পদক্ষেপের হুমকি দেন।

item.title: Meta Postpones New Business Terms Following Publisher Concerns
item.description: Meta has postponed implementing its updated business conditions after news publishers expressed worry that the rules might permit unauthorized AI scraping of their articles.

item.title: Indian Spirits Industry Seeks Scotch Whisky Duty Reduction
item.description: The International Spirits and Wines Association of India has requested the government to lower Scotch whisky import duties from 150% to 75%, impacting ongoing trade discussions.

item.title: APSRTC Discussions Collapse as Unions Demand E-Bus Tender Revocation
item.description: Negotiations involving APSRTC broke down because labor representatives insisted on scrapping 1,450 electric bus tenders. The Joint Action Committee also demands 15,000 vacant positions be filled and 4,000 diesel vehicles acquired.

item.title: Two Suspects Apprehended After Eating-House Worker Slain in Karaikudi
item.description: Police have taken two individuals into custody following the fatal attack on a dining establishment worker in Karaikudi. Authorities are investigating the homicide.

item.title: Refusal of Yelahanka Estate for Family Wedding Triggers Political Dispute
item.description: A political controversy arose after YS Jagan reportedly refused to let YS Sharmila use the Yelahanka Palace in Bengaluru for her daughter's wedding. Family intermediaries failed to convince him, highlighting the ongoing friction between the siblings.

item.title: SVU Academic Event Highlights Growing Need for AI in Public Administration
item.description: Specialists participating in an SVU seminar emphasized that artificial intelligence is becoming vital for administrative functions. Discussions focused on the integration of digital tools into public sector operations.

item.title: Two Pupils Killed in Collision Between Motorcycle and Earthmover Near Chittoor
item.description: A fatal traffic accident occurred close to Chittoor when a two-wheeler collided with an earthmover. Two students lost their lives in the crash.

item.title: Cabinet Minister Launches Upgrades at Pair of Fishing Harbours
item.description: Infrastructure upgrades were officially opened at two fishing ports, featuring a 21.7-crore project at Puthiyappa and a 20.90-crore second phase at Koyilandy. These improvements comprise auction halls, parking lots, internal roads, a finger jetty, and cold storage.

item.title: Traffic Collision in Sivaganga Results in One Fatality
item.description: A vehicular crash in the Sivaganga district has left one person dead. Local authorities are reviewing the circumstances surrounding the incident.

item.title: Punjab Premier Claims Delhi Airport Detention Stemmed from Political Pressure
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann stated in the state assembly that Delhi airport officials delayed him due to outside pressure. He criticized customs leadership connections, prompting the legislature to adopt a resolution.

item.title: Yathindra Blames Aspirant for Karnataka Sting, KPCC Acts
item.description: Yathindra claimed a female candidate seeking a ticket engineered the Karnataka sting operation. Meanwhile, the KPCC plans to send a show-cause notice to Kripa Alva.

item.title: Police in Koratty Seize 11 Tonnes of Banned Tobacco
item.description: Authorities confiscated 3.76 lakh packets of prohibited tobacco hidden under onions in a truck, resulting in two arrests. This marks one of the largest seizures in central Kerala recently.

item.title: Sigma Unveils FP2 Camera with Major Enhancements
item.description: Seven years after launching its initial compact full-frame mirrorless camera, Sigma has revealed the FP2. The new model introduces a better sensor and an articulating screen while maintaining a small build.

item.title: Guardian To Host Live Q&A on French Unrest
item.description: European columnists Rokhaya Diallo and Alexander Hurst will answer reader questions regarding recent unrest in France. The live session is scheduled for Friday, October 23, at 3pm BST.

item.title: American Express Reduces Staff by 5% for AI Readiness
item.description: American Express is reducing its staff by 5% as part of AI preparations, CEO Stephen Squeri announced on Friday. The company is recording a $336 million restructuring charge for the third quarter.

item.title: DVAC Officials Confiscate Unaccounted Cash in Devakottai
item.description: Anti-corruption officials recovered ₹62,500 in unexplained cash from the municipal office in Devakottai during a raid.

item.title: NCTB to Revise Class VI ICT Book Over Weighing Scale Icon
item.description: The NCTB is modifying the 2027 Class VI ICT textbook after criticism arose over depicting a weighing scale as a symbol of wisdom instead of a brain.

item.title: Ian Poulter Exits LIV Golf to Focus on Sons and YouTube
item.description: Ian Poulter has departed from LIV Golf as prominent players continue to leave the organization. He plans to focus on growing his YouTube channel and supporting his sons' golf careers.

item.title: PSG and Lyon Match Rescheduled Due to Paris Protests
item.description: The Ligue 1 fixture between Paris St-Germain and Lyon has been postponed by one day. The rescheduling occurs as Paris braces for additional weekend demonstrations.

item.title: ঢাকা পর্বের নারী ফুটবল টুর্নামেন্ট শুরু আগামীকাল
item.description: আগামী ২৪ অক্টোবর থেকে ড্যাফোডিল ইন্টারন্যাশনাল ইউনিভার্সিটিতে শুরু হচ্ছে প্রথম আলো-স্টার নিউজ নারী ফুটবল একাডেমির ঢাকা পর্ব। বিভিন্ন একাডেমি দল এই প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশ নেবে।

item.title: কক্সবাজারের হোটেলে আগুন, পর্যটকদের সৈকতে অবস্থান
item.description: সুগন্ধা পয়েন্ট এলাকার দ্য সি-প্রিন্সেস নামক তারকা হোটেলে অগ্নিকাণ্ডের ঘটনা ঘটেছে। ওই সময় হোটেলটির প্রায় তিন শ পর্যটক বাইরে সৈকতে চলে আসেন।

item.title: Residents Demand Guaranteed Water Supply Amid Crisis
item.description: Local voters are questioning candidates about dependable drinking water and permanent solutions following recent shortages and financial burdens.

item.title: Bagalkot Bank Employee Falls Victim to Trading Fraud
item.description: An online investment scam has resulted in financial losses for a banking professional located in Bagalkot.

item.title: Ukrainian Starlink Speeds Remain Restricted Despite Restoration Claims
item.description: Authorities report that Ukraine's satellite internet connection remains capped at 161 km/h, impacting essential air defense operations. This comes despite earlier statements suggesting full functionality had been recovered.

item.title: Paris Shooting Incident Treated as Terrorist Act
item.description: Authorities are probing a fatal shooting near Paris as terrorism after one person died and five others sustained injuries. The alleged shooter is currently in custody.

item.title: India Secures Easy Win via Rawal and Shree Charani
item.description: India achieved a smooth victory supported by a century from Rawal and four wickets by Shree Charani. Contributions from Shafali Verma and Kranti Gaud also aided the win.

item.title: Gudur MPTC Nominations File Without Incidents Under Guard
item.description: Candidates submitted their nomination papers for the MPTC elections in Gudur peacefully. The process took place under strict security measures.

item.title: Kerala University Special Convocation Sparks Political Debate
item.description: Syndicate members expressed worries regarding declining academic and administrative standards. This criticism arose despite the university holding a NAAC A++ rating.

item.title: Yathindra Inspects Garbage Removal in Lalithadripura
item.description: Yathindra traveled to Lalithadripura to check on garbage clearance activities. The official reviewed the current cleanup progress at the location.

item.title: Bihar Siwan District Explosion Leaves Four Dead
item.description: At least four individuals lost their lives in a house explosion in Bihar's Siwan district. The blast took place in a residence used for manufacturing firecrackers, and emergency rescue work is ongoing.

item.title: Airlines Remain Calm Despite Lower Passenger Numbers
item.description: Carriers noted reduced passenger volumes in the third quarter following steep ticket price increases driven by fuel expenses. Despite this drop, industry executives report that customers are largely accepting the higher costs.

item.title: Tiruppur District to Receive New Cauvery Water Supply
item.description: A newly launched Cauvery Combined Water Supply Scheme is set to supply water to 1,232 rural communities across the Tiruppur district. The project aims to improve drinking water access for these villages.

item.title: Young Girl Dies in Yadagirigutta Temple Tank Incident
item.description: A four-year-old female child tragically drowned inside a temple tank located in Yadagirigutta. Local authorities are investigating the circumstances of the fatal incident.

item.title: Thrissur Theater Festival Appoints Director and Opens Calls
item.description: Deepan Sivaraman has been appointed director for the 17th international theatre festival in Thrissur, scheduled for February 21 to 28. Organizers have opened application submissions under the theme 'Imagining Justice'.

item.title: Kalaburagi Police Apprehend Three Burglars and Recover Valuables
item.description: Law enforcement in Kalaburagi detained three suspects linked to a burglary case. Officers recovered silver and gold jewelry, along with a motorcycle utilized during the offense, totaling ₹5.50 lakh in seized goods.

item.title: Maine Landlord Settles Overcharging Dispute for $3.6 Million
item.description: Landlord Geoffrey Rice reached a $3.6 million settlement with the Trelawny Tenants Union to compensate over 1,000 renters. The agreement resolves mediation regarding excessive rent increases charged since 2020.

item.title: Authorities seize 40 marijuana plants in Adilabad
item.description: During an ongoing initiative against illegal narcotics, law enforcement officials recovered 40 cannabis plants in Adilabad district. The seizure is part of a wider effort to eliminate the cultivation of prohibited substances in the region.

item.title: খেজুরের গুড় দিয়ে চা তৈরির পদ্ধতি
item.description: ৭৫০ মিলিলিটার পানি গরম করে তাতে গুঁড়া দুধ ও এলাচি মিশিয়ে ফুটিয়ে নিতে হয়। মিশ্রণটি ঘন হয়ে এলে চা পাতা যোগ করতে হবে। স্বাদ অনুযায়ী খেজুরের গুড় ব্যবহার করে এই পানীয় প্রস্তুত করা সম্ভব।

item.title: Heavy rainfall impacts Tiruchi and surrounding delta regions
item.description: Intense precipitation has affected several districts, including Tiruchi, where traffic and electricity services were interrupted. A fatal lightning strike occurred in Ariyalur, while Kodavasal recorded 11 cm of rain during the downpour.

item.title: সাতক্ষীরায় ছাত্রকে যৌন নিপীড়নের অভিযোগে মাদ্রাসা শিক্ষক আটক
item.description: তথ্যপ্রযুক্তির সহায়তায় তিন ঘণ্টার এক অভিযানে সাতক্ষীরা সদর উপজেলার পরানদহা থেকে অভিযুক্ত শিক্ষককে গ্রেপ্তার করা হয়েছে। নিজের কক্ষে ডেকে নিয়ে শিক্ষার্থীকে যৌন হয়রানি করার অভিযোগে তার বিরুদ্ধে এই ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া হয়।

item.title: Antonio Conte refutes claims regarding Manchester United coaching role
item.description: Former Chelsea manager Antonio Conte has dismissed rumors connecting him to a position at Manchester United. He characterized reports suggesting he requested total authority over the club's operations as baseless.

item.title: Body camera footage of infant's fatal shooting released in Mississippi
item.description: Authorities in Mississippi have made public the body camera video documenting the police shooting of one-year-old Kohen Wiley. The release provides visual evidence of the incident that resulted in the child's death.

item.title: HITEX to host 16th NAREDCO Telangana Property Show from October 30
item.description: The 16th annual property exhibition organized by NAREDCO Telangana is scheduled to commence on October 30. The event will take place at the HITEX Exhibition Centre.

item.title: India achieves record-breaking 114 medals at Asian Para Games
item.description: Indian para-athletes secured a total of 114 medals, including 30 golds, surpassing their previous best of 108. This performance represents the country's highest-ever medal tally in the history of the competition.

item.title: Funeral shooting in southern Jordan leaves six dead and numerous wounded
item.description: Local officials report that two unknown attackers fired upon mourners during a funeral at a southern Jordanian church. The incident resulted in six fatalities and multiple injuries.
